notes.title: 《心动恋旅：樱花篇》1.0.2版本更新公告
notes.content: [p]Version 1.0.2 Update Notice[/p][p] [/p][p]Dear Players,[/p][p]Since the game's launch, we have received enthusiastic feedback from everyone. Every suggestion and every bug report has been carefully recorded, and we have conducted specialized investigations and fixes for core issues. Here, we sincerely thank you for your understanding and trust, and we apologize for the long wait for this update.[/p][p] [/p][p]To provide a smoother and more polished gaming experience, we will release the 1.0.2 version update on September 13, 2025, focusing on the following improvements:[/p][p] [/p][p]Optimized music and sound effect settings to ensure stable saving after configuration.[/p][p]Optimized full-screen settings to ensure stable saving after configuration.[/p][p]Fixed achievement system issues, enabling achievements to be re-scanned and activated, resolving abnormalities such as achievement confusion and failure to trigger.[/p][p]Added text descriptions to the "New Game" pop-up window to clarify button functions.[/p][p]Updated some in-game image assets to enhance the visual experience.[/p][p]Optimized some in-game text descriptions for better accuracy.[/p][p]Fixed a screen freeze issue caused by skipping the opening video.[/p][p]Fixed a "black screen" issue during the playback of some in-game videos.[/p][p]............​[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]This update will not affect your current game progress. Simply download and overwrite the current version to complete the update. The update package is approximately 200MB, so we recommend updating in a stable network environment.[/p][p] [/p][p]If any issues persist after the update, please feel free to join our official QQ group to provide feedback. We will prioritize investigating and fixing reported issues and promptly release patches.[/p][p] [/p][p]Finally, thank you once again for choosing and supporting Heartbeat Journey: Sakura Chapter. As a new title developed by a new team, the game still has room for improvement, and we deeply appreciate your willingness to grow with us. We hope this "Sakura Journey" brings you a wonderful experience. Wishing you all a joyful gaming time![/p][p] [/p][p]Heartbeat Journey: Sakura Chapter Production Team[/p][p]Official QQ Group: 946625979[/p]

notes.title: Official Announcement for "Heartfelt Journey: Sakura Chapter" - September
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Dear Players,
"Heartfelt Journey: Sakura Chapter" has been officially released for a week now. We sincerely thank you for your support and love! Every bit of your attention is a crucial motivation for us to move forward. Regarding the core concerns raised by players about the \[1.0.1] version, we have compiled detailed answers to provide clearer guidance.[/p][h3][b]1. Core Gameplay FAQs (Favorability / Exploration / Achievements)[/b][/h3][p][b]1. Favorability Guide[/b]
In the current version, a single playthrough allows you to unlock a maximum of 100+ favorability points for two main characters simultaneously. To maximize the favorability of the remaining heroines, click "New Game" on the main interface to start a new playthrough. Use the player’s fast-forward feature or directly skip to branch points to focus on the corresponding characters. This is a speedrun mode, which takes an average of 5-10 minutes to complete.
Friendly reminder: Starting a "New Game" only resets current favorability and exploration progress. Previously unlocked achievements, photo collections, video playback history, and other content will remain intact, so there’s no need to worry about data loss.[/p][p][b]2. Exploration Guide[/b]
Currently, the exploration points that players find challenging are主要集中在 two chapters. The specific unlocking methods are as follows:[/p][p][b]Chapter 1 (Encounter in Tokyo)[/b]: In the rock-paper-scissors segment with Xiaolan, achieve a score of 100 or higher to unlock 4 hidden videos. Additionally, Xiaolan must complete all three gestures: rock, paper, and scissors. Also, in this chapter, it is recommended to carefully inspect Xiaolan’s room to avoid missing exploration points.[/p][p][b]Chapter 6 (Sweet Crisis)[/b]: For all questions posed to the five heroines, select every option, including "none of the above," to achieve full exploration progress.[/p][p][b]3. Achievement Guide[/b]
The achievement system is deeply tied to favorability and exploration progress. Completing these two aspects will essentially unlock all achievements (multiple players have already achieved full completion). If you encounter stuck achievements, it is likely due to device-specific bugs. Please join the official discussion group to report the issue, and we will assist in troubleshooting as soon as possible.
Additionally, players \[JohnWDC] and \[moonilght12345] have compiled detailed full walkthroughs. Click the links below to view them:[/p][p]【JohnWDC】[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.bilibili.com/opus/1106129884647784482?from=search&spm_id_from=333.337.0.0"]https://www.bilibili.com/opus/1106129884647784482?from=search&spm_id_from=333.337.0.0[/url][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]【moonilght12345】[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.bilibili.com/opus/1107019131871297540?from=search&spm_id_from=333.337.0.0"]https://www.bilibili.com/opus/1107019131871297540?from=search&spm_id_from=333.337.0.0[/url][/p][p]
For more guides, search for 【Heartfelt Journey Sakura Chapter - Column】 on Bilibili. We extend our sincere gratitude to all players who have shared their strategies![/p][h3][b]2. Explanation and Apology Regarding the Endings[/b][/h3][p]After the release, we carefully collected player reviews and live-stream feedback. We are aware that the endings for the four Japanese heroines did not meet everyone’s expectations. Due to objective factors such as review processes and filming constraints, the endings were presented in a relatively abbreviated manner. This is not only a regret for players but also a lingering concern for our development team.
We humbly accept all your criticisms and suggestions and have already started discussions on remedial plans for the endings. There may be special projects and surprise events in the future, so stay tuned![/p][h3][b]3. Version Update Plan[/b][/h3][p]Regarding bugs reported by players, such as black screens, card headers, stuck achievements, screen adaptation issues, settings not saving, and volume function problems, we have recorded all feedback and started修复工作. The \[1.0.2] version update is expected to be released by mid-September. Specific details will be announced in a separate update notice.
As a startup team focused on the interactive video game领域, we always aim to "restore the authentic Japanese atmosphere and polish high-quality福利内容." Despite our full efforts, there are still many shortcomings. In the future, we will continue to reflect, actively learn from industry experiences, and constantly optimize the game experience.[/p][p]Once again, thank you for your understanding and support. Welcome to join our official group (Group ID: 946625979) to communicate directly with us. We look forward to growing together with all of you![/p][p][b]Production Team of "Heartfelt Journey: Sakura Chapter"[/b][/p]

notes.title: Call for Creative Editing Works with Rewards
notes.content: [p][b]Dear Players,[/b][/p][p align="justify"][b]We know many of you enjoy editing and creating secondary content based on your favorite in-game material. It is thanks to you that our game has reached a wider audience. To express gratitude to these dedicated creators and reciprocate your love and support for the game, we have launched a welfare event exclusively for secondary creators. Starting today, all secondary creation works of Heartbeat Love Journey: Cherry Blossom Chapter posted on Douyin and Bilibili will be eligible for welfare rewards, and selected works may even be featured on the game’s store page![/b][/p][p align="justify"][b]Please note that when posting your secondary creation content, you must add the hashtag #HeartbeatLoveJourneyCherryBlossomChapter and tag the official Douyin and Bilibili accounts of Heartbeat Love Journey: Cherry Blossom Chapter. We will select the top 50 works (based on data) from each platform (100 works in total) to award prizes:[/b][/p][p align="justify"][b]1st–3rd Place: Huawei MatePad + Autograph of the Designated Heroine[/b][/p][p align="justify"][b]4th–10th Place: Customized Merchandise + Random Autographed Photo[/b][/p][p align="justify"][b]11th–50th Place: Limited-Edition Merchandise[/b][/p][p align="justify"][b]——————[/b][/p][p align="justify"][b]Data Calculation Rules:[/b][/p][p align="justify"][b]1 point for each like[/b][/p][p align="justify"][b]2 points for each share[/b][/p][p align="justify"][b]3 points for each comment[/b][/p][p align="justify"][b]Note: Artificial data manipulation (e.g., fake likes/shares/comments) is strictly prohibited. The review team reserves the right to disqualify any work found violating this rule.[/b][/p][p align="justify"][b]——————[/b][/p][p align="justify"][b]Event Period: From August 28, 2025 (posting start date) to 12:00 (noon) on September 10, 2025.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Selection of High-Quality Reviews
notes.content: [p]Dear Players,[/p][p]We are thrilled to announce that the first installment of our Heartbeat Love Journey series, "Sakura Chapter," is finally here! Our development team is eager to interact with all of you and hear your thoughts on our "brainchild." We want to know how you would rate the game![/p][p]That’s why we’re launching this special event: We encourage you to share your reviews and expectations for the game in the STEAM comments section. Our customer support team will reply to selected comments, and those officially picked will randomly receive carefully prepared gifts, including:[/p][p]Autographed photos by the actors[/p][p]Game merchandise (customized pillows, mouse pads, omamori charms, towels, unsigned posters, etc.)[/p][p]Props used during filming[/p][p]While we aimed to deliver a perfect game, this was our first production. Limited experience and challenges during overseas filming meant there might be some shortcomings. We’ve conducted multiple reviews to learn and improve, and we truly hope to hear your valuable feedback and suggestions in the comments. We’ll strive to do even better in our next project![/p][p]How to Claim Your Prize:[/p][p]If your comment receives an official reply, please fill out the online form with your basic information (contact details + screenshot of your STEAM profile + screenshot of the official reply). Our customer service will contact you and arrange for gift delivery.[/p][p]Note: Due to international shipping requirements for autographed items from Japanese actors, please allow approximately one month for delivery.[/p][p]Event Period:[/p][p]Starts: August 27, 2025[/p][p]Ends: September 10, 2025[/p][p]We can’t wait to hear from you![/p][p]Thank you for your support![/p][p][/p]
